poolFile: pool.jsonl.gz (line 1: release/seed/funnel; then PoolVariant per line)

annotations.transcriptSelection: within the pool gene (ClinVar GENEINFO symbol) only: MANE Select, then canonical, then the most severe consequence; VEP's flag_pick is ignored because it can land on an overlapping gene

excludedUnmappedGene.reason: no VEP transcript consequence for the pool gene

endpoints.vep: https://vep-link.genefoundry.org/mcp annotate_variants_batch (response_mode=full; MANE Select > canonical; CADD from position_scores)
endpoints.gnomad: https://gnomad-link.genefoundry.org/mcp get_variant_frequencies (gnomad_r4 v4.1.1, exclude_zero_populations=false; popmax excludes ami/asj/fin/mid/remaining)

localVep: VEP 115.2 offline cache + dbNSFP 5.3.1a (CADD_phred, gnomAD4.1_joint_AF, gnomAD4.1_joint_POPMAX_AF); --everything, pick order mane_select,canonical,appris,tsl,biotype,ccds,rank,length
